description: If you've been searching for a capable, family-friendly SUV that delivers proven reliability without the new-car price tag, this 2012 Honda Pilot EX-L for sale at R&A Auto Sales in Sacramento, California deserves a close look. With its commanding black exterior, three-row seating, and Honda's legendary V6 powertrain, this Pilot checks nearly every box for buyers across the Sacramento region who need a vehicle that works as hard as they do.About This 2012 Honda Pilot EX-L This particular Pilot comes in a sharp black exterior finish and wears the EX-L badge  Honda's well-equipped leather trim that sits above the base and EX grades. At 179,695 miles, this is a high-mileage vehicle, and that transparency matters. The good news is that the Honda Pilot's 3.5-liter V6 is one of the most durable engines in the SUV segment, and many Pilots with proper maintenance routinely push well past 200,000 miles. Buyers who understand Honda's long-term durability track record will recognize that high mileage on this platform is very different from high mileage on many competing vehicles. A pre-purchase inspection is always a smart move, and R&A Auto Sales welcomes the conversation.2012 Honda Pilot Performance and EngineV6 i-VTEC Power and Four-Wheel Drive Capability Under the hood sits Honda's 3.5-liter V6 paired with i-VTEC variable valve timing technology. This engine produces a smooth, confident power delivery that feels at home whether you're merging onto Interstate 5, climbing into the Sierra Nevada foothills, or hauling a full load of passengers and gear. The five-speed automatic transmission keeps things simple and dependable  fewer moving parts means fewer things to go wrong over time.The four-wheel drive system gives this Pilot genuine all-weather and light off-road capability. For Sacramento-area drivers who make weekend trips to Lake Tahoe, South Lake Tahoe, or the Sierra Nevada mountains, that added traction during winter road conditions is a meaningful advantage over a standard front-wheel drive crossover.Honda Pilot EX-L Features and InteriorWhat the EX-L Trim Brings to the Table The EX-L trim level in the 2012 Honda Pilot was designed with comfort-minded families in mind. Expect leather-trimmed seating surfaces, a power-adjustable driver's seat, heated front seats, a sunroof, and Honda's integrated rear-seat entertainment-ready structure. The cabin is genuinely spacious across all three rows, making this one of the more practical three-row options in its class.Cargo flexibility is a hallmark of the Pilot's design.
